description:
Input for find_jurisdictions_with_rising_activity.

Scans all jurisdictions for a pathogen/signal and returns those with a
rising trend, optionally filtered to an HHS region.

pathogen.description: Respiratory pathogen: 'influenza', 'covid19', or 'rsv'. Aliases: 'flu' → influenza, 'covid'/'sars-cov-2' → covid19.

hhs_region.description: Filter to a specific HHS region (1–10). Omit to scan all 50 states + DC.
hhs_region.title: Hhs Region

min_level.description: Minimum CDC official level to include (Very Low | Low | Medium | High | Very High). Applies only to hospital_admissions signal.
min_level.title: Min Level

limit.description: Maximum number of jurisdictions to return (1–56).
limit.title: Limit

as_of.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) to restrict analysis to data on or before this date. Omit to use the most recent available data. Useful for reproducible demos and evaluation.
as_of.title: As Of
